Not computed — synastry: needs a second chart: the engine reads one chart, describes a relationship only as this chart shows it, and says nothing of another person's own chart or life
Not computed — rectification: the birth time is not rectified: each finding carries its stability over the time window instead
Not computed — probability: no area has a calibrated probability: probability stays null until outcome data calibrates it
Not computed — score learned: no learned score: score_learned is null until a model is trained on outcomes
Not computed — special lagnas: the special lagnas (Hora, Ghati, Indu, Sree, Varnada) are not computed

Not computed — retrieval: no corpus of the classical texts is searched: the verses a [text:] tag cites are those checked on rules; a [tradition:] citation is the writer's own, unverified and shown apart
Not computed — question routing: a question is routed to its areas by keyword; no model translates it into a query
Not computed — tara scoring: the transit taras are tagged but not scored: the timing join leaves them out
Not computed — draft placements: a placement's effect is a draft until its verse is read: it weighs nothing and is not narrated
Not computed — varga dignity nodes: a varga dignity is read for the seven planets only; the nodes' dignity is a matter on which the texts differ, and the lagna has none

Not computed — transit areas: a transit window's or tara row's areas_touched is the area-houses mapping counted from the Moon and from the lagna; it says which areas' houses the transit occupies, not what it does there, and the engine scores a transit for an area only in the timing join
Not computed — never: the engine never times death, diagnoses illness, advises a trade or investment, or states another person's fate
